title: Part 3 : 2021: METHODS FOR TESTING TAR AND BITUMINOUS MATERIALS - Determination of Viscosity-Part 3 Kinematic Viscosity-
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 3) covers the method for the determination of kinematic viscosity of paving grade and cut-back bitumen and distillation residues of cut-backs. It is applicable to the materials having a viscosity range of 30-100 000 cSt.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Glossary of Terms Relating to Bitumen and Tar

clause_3_terminology: Kinematic Viscosity of a Newtonian Liquid
Part 3 : 2021: METHODS FOR TESTING TAR AND BITUMINOUS MATERIALS

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
